text:
camille: heads up — noticed SDK falling back to project key even when REDWOOD_ORG_KEY is set in env
ben: wait, how did you repro?
camille: ran the onboarding sampleapp, steps were super simple but behavior surprised me
camille: ```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=proj_abc
export REDWOOD_ORG_KEY=org_xyz
node sampleapp/index.js --project foo
```
ben: hmm, expected SDK to prefer ORG key for org-scoped calls
sophia: current precedence is: cli flag > config file > env var > metadata service (and then cache). It also treats REDWOOD_API_KEY as atomic, doesn't split org/project semantics
oli: and env var precedence code doesn't check for separate ORG vs PROJECT env names — it just looks for REDWOOD_API_KEY first
camille: result was that the process kept using the project-scoped key which expired during onboarding (rotation happened), sampleapp errored and didn't auto-recover
ben: does the SDK invalidate cached static env keys on 401?
sophia: only for refreshable providers. Static env keys are assumed immutable for process lifetime so no invalidation path exists
camille: so if a long-running sample or local dev server relies on env keys with rotation, it breaks until restart — bad DX
ben: proposal: emit a one-time warning on SDK init if a static env key is detected AND process uptime > 5m (or if we detect retries/401s)
oli: + suggestion: fallback rules — if project key returns 403/401, attempt ORG key when available before failing the request
camille: is that safe re: scope boundaries? we shouldn't accidentally elevate permissions
sophia: we should check target API endpoint scope. Only allow org-key fallback for endpoints that accept org-level tokens. Also log telemetry for any automatic scope fallback so we can audit
ben: agree. Also add a clear msg in sampleapp onboarding: "If you rotate keys, restart the local server or use refreshable provider"
camille: can we also add CLI niceties: a `redwood auth check` that reports which key is being used and last validation time? Super helpful for onboarding
oli: +1. That would have saved us an hour today
sophia: I'll open a single devex ticket: /labels sdk, auth, onboarding. Plan: 1) add init warning, 2) add fallback logic + audits, 3) sampleapp doc + cli auth-check
camille: tagging @security for review on fallback semantics — want to make sure we don't introduce privilege escalation risks @security-team
security-bot: noted — please add a short threat-model checklist to the ticket before implementation (token scope checks, audit events, opt-out flag)
ben: i'll start a tiny PR for the init-warning + unit tests (mock env + simulated 401)
camille: thanks! i'll update the sampleapp README and add a one-liner in the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
